tasks.name: 01-top-nav
tasks.js: () => { const out = []; document.querySelectorAll('[class*="menu"],[class*="nav"]').forEach(el => { if (el.children.length < 14) { const t = (el.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(); if (t) out.push({ tag: el.tagName, cls: String(el.className).slice(0,60), text: t.slice(0,50) }) } }); return out.slice(0, 120) }

tasks.name: 03-side-menu
tasks.js: () => { const out = []; document.querySelectorAll('aside *, .el-menu-item, .el-submenu__title, [class*="sidebar"] *').forEach(el => { const t = (el.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(); if (t && t.length < 24 && el.children.length < 6) out.push({ tag: el.tagName, cls: String(el.className).slice(0,50), text: t }) }); const seen = new Set(); return out.filter(x => !seen.has(x.text) && seen.add(x.text)).slice(0, 150) }
